description: This file contains an extension to the ChannelsSettings class providing helper methods to convert milliseconds to Date objects and to generate NSImage objects from base64-encoded data URLs.

methods.name: date(fromMs:)
methods.description: Converts a millisecond timestamp (Double?) to a Date? object.

methods.name: qrImage(from:)
methods.description: Creates an NSImage from a data URL containing a base64-encoded image.
